Part of the analysis code for the matched liver–serum multi-omics study in MASLD. This script is self-contained: open it in RStudio (or `rmarkdown::render("Fig5_pPRS.Rmd")` from this folder). It first loads the workspace of the previous step (`Fig4_paired_liver_serum`), running that script if needed. Input data are read from `data/` (see `data/README.md`); Supplementary Tables used here are in `Source_data/`; Source Data for this item are written to `Source_data/`; other outputs go to `results/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
}
source(file.path(.root, "common", "setup.R"))
```

# Partitioned polygenic risk scores: Fig. 5 and Table S12

pPRS, liver-serum uncoupling and mediation through hepatic triglycerides.

```{r partitio-01}
## =====================================================================
##  Partitioned polygenic risk scores (pPRS) and liver–serum uncoupling
##
##  RUN THIS IN THE SAME R SESSION, RIGHT AFTER Robustness_liver_serum_v2.R
##  (it reuses: meta, df, paired, Lp, Sp, Ll, zL, zS, D, panel, tg_cols,
##   run_limma, cv_auc, Xclin, BASE, TRAITS, KEY6, extra_ok, FDR, N_REP)
##
##  Step 1  sanity check: do the scores behave as expected?
##          (discordant: liver TG up, serum TG down; concordant: both up)
##  Step 2  pPRS as covariates (answers the PNPLA3/TM6SF2 reviewer point)
##  Step 3  does genetic hepatic lipid retention (discordant pPRS)
##          uncouple liver and serum?
##            3a  liver–serum correlation of the same metabolite, low vs high pPRS
##            3b  liver TG vs serum TG coupling x pPRS interaction
##            3c  liver-minus-serum gap vs pPRS
##            3d  serum AUC for histology, low vs high pPRS
##  Step 4  genetic mediation: pPRS -> hepatic TG -> histology
##
##  Output: pprs_liver_serum/  -> all CSVs + summary_pprs.txt
## =====================================================================
need <- c("meta", "df", "paired", "Lp", "Sp", "Ll", "zL", "zS", "D", "panel",
          "tg_cols", "run_limma", "cv_auc", "Xclin", "BASE", "TRAITS", "KEY6")
miss <- need[!vapply(need, exists, logical(1))]
if (length(miss)) stop("run Robustness_liver_serum_v2.R first; missing: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "))
if (!exists("extra_ok")) extra_ok <- character(0)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(readxl); library(pROC); library(mediation) })
set.seed(20260921)
OUTP <- "pprs_liver_serum"; dir.create(OUTP, showWarnings = FALSE)
PPRS_FILE <- file.path(project_dir, "PRS_analysis/pprs.xlsx")
N_PERM <- 2000        # permutations for step 3a
N_BOOT <- 2000        # bootstrap resamples for mediation (step 4)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 0. read pPRS, match IDs (MF1 -> LIVMF1), standardise
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
pp <- as.data.frame(read_excel(PPRS_FILE))
names(pp) <- trimws(names(pp))
pp$id <- ifelse(grepl("^LIV", pp$ID), pp$ID, paste0("LIV", pp$ID))
cat("pPRS rows:", nrow(pp), "| matching metadata:", sum(pp$id %in% meta$id),
    "| matching paired set:", sum(pp$id %in% paired), "\n")
zsc <- function(v) as.numeric(scale(v))
meta$pprs_conc <- zsc(as.numeric(pp$Concordant)[match(meta$id, pp$id)])
meta$pprs_disc <- zsc(as.numeric(pp$Discordant)[match(meta$id, pp$id)])
df$pprs_conc <- meta$pprs_conc[match(rownames(df), meta$id)]
df$pprs_disc <- meta$pprs_disc[match(rownames(df), meta$id)]
cat("correlation concordant vs discordant pPRS:",
    round(cor(meta$pprs_conc, meta$pprs_disc, use = "complete"), 2), "\n")
## hepatic TG index for everyone with lipidomics (same definition as v2)
TG_all <- rowMeans(scale(Ll[, tg_cols]), na.rm = TRUE)
meta$TG_liver <- zsc(TG_all[meta$id])
meta$TG_serum <- zsc(log(as.numeric(meta$TG_mgdL)))
meta$steat_grade <- as.numeric(meta$steatosis_Kleiner)
meta$NAS <- as.numeric(meta$NAS_score)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 1. sanity check (linear models adjusted for age, sex, BMI)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
assoc <- function(y, x, data, covs = BASE) {
  d <- data[, c(y, x, covs)]; d <- d[complete.cases(d), ]
  s <- summary(lm(reformulate(c(x, covs), y), d))$coefficients[x, ]
  data.frame(outcome = y, pPRS = x, n = nrow(d), beta_per_SD = round(s[1], 3),
             SE = round(s[2], 3), p = signif(s[4], 3), row.names = NULL)
}
s1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("TG_liver", "TG_serum", "steat_grade", "NAS"), function(y)
  rbind(assoc(y, "pprs_conc", meta), assoc(y, "pprs_disc", meta))))
s1$expected_sign <- with(s1, ifelse(outcome == "TG_serum" & pPRS == "pprs_disc", "-", "+"))
s1$as_expected <- sign(s1$beta_per_SD) == ifelse(s1$expected_sign == "+", 1, -1)
write.csv(s1, file.path(OUTP, "1_sanity_check.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n== Step 1: sanity check ==\n"); print(s1, row.names = FALSE)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 2. pPRS as covariates in the paired analysis
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
cov_sets <- list(
  base               = BASE,
  pPRS               = c(BASE, "pprs_conc", "pprs_disc"),
  pPRS_TG_glycaemia  = c(BASE, "pprs_conc", "pprs_disc", "TG_index", extra_ok))
s2 <- list(); s2aa <- list()
for (cn in names(cov_sets)) for (t in TRAITS) {
  cv <- cov_sets[[cn]]
  hl <- run_limma(Lp[paired, ], df, t, cv)
  hs <- run_limma(Sp[paired, ], df, t, cv)
  dd <- run_limma(D, df, t, cv)
  s2[[length(s2) + 1]] <- data.frame(model = cn, trait = t, n = hl$n[1],
    hepatic_sig = sum(hl$FDR <= FDR), serum_sig = sum(hs$FDR <= FDR),
    discordant = sum(dd$FDR <= FDR), key6_discordant = sum(dd$FDR[dd$feature %in% KEY6] <= FDR),
    discordant_list = paste(dd$feature[dd$FDR <= FDR], collapse = ";"))
  s2aa[[length(s2aa) + 1]] <- data.frame(model = cn, trait = t, metabolite = KEY6,
    diff_logFC = round(dd$logFC[match(KEY6, dd$feature)], 3),
    diff_FDR = signif(dd$FDR[match(KEY6, dd$feature)], 3))
}
s2 <- do.call(rbind, s2); s2aa <- do.call(rbind, s2aa)
write.csv(s2, file.path(OUTP, "2_pprs_adjusted_counts.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(s2aa, file.path(OUTP, "2_pprs_adjusted_amino_acids.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n== Step 2: pPRS-adjusted paired analysis ==\n"); print(s2[, 1:7], row.names = FALSE)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3a. liver–serum correlation of each matched metabolite: low vs high discordant pPRS
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
okp <- !is.na(df$pprs_disc)
g_hi <- df$pprs_disc[okp] > median(df$pprs_disc[okp])
zL3 <- zL[okp, , drop = FALSE]; zS3 <- zS[okp, , drop = FALSE]
rho_by <- function(grp) sapply(panel, function(m) {
  c(lo = cor(zL3[!grp, m], zS3[!grp, m], method = "spearman", use = "complete"),
    hi = cor(zL3[grp, m],  zS3[grp, m],  method = "spearman", use = "complete"))
})
r_obs <- rho_by(g_hi)
stat_obs <- median(r_obs["hi", ] - r_obs["lo", ])
perm <- replicate(N_PERM, { r <- rho_by(sample(g_hi)); median(r["hi", ] - r["lo", ]) })
p_perm <- (sum(abs(perm) >= abs(stat_obs)) + 1) / (N_PERM + 1)
## per-metabolite interaction: serum ~ liver x pPRS_disc
inter <- do.call(rbind, lapply(panel, function(m) {
  d <- data.frame(s = zS[, m], l = zL[, m], g = df$pprs_disc, df[, BASE])
  d <- d[complete.cases(d), ]
  co <- summary(lm(s ~ l * g + age + sex + bmi, d))$coefficients
  data.frame(metabolite = m, rho_low_pPRS = round(r_obs["lo", m], 3), rho_high_pPRS = round(r_obs["hi", m], 3),
             interaction_beta = round(co["l:g", 1], 3), interaction_p = signif(co["l:g", 4], 3))
}))
inter$interaction_FDR <- signif(p.adjust(inter$interaction_p, "BH"), 3)
s3a <- data.frame(n_low = sum(!g_hi), n_high = sum(g_hi),
                  median_rho_low = round(median(r_obs["lo", ]), 3),
                  median_rho_high = round(median(r_obs["hi", ]), 3),
                  median_difference_high_minus_low = round(stat_obs, 3),
                  permutation_p = signif(p_perm, 3),
                  metabolites_weaker_in_high = sum(r_obs["hi", ] < r_obs["lo", ]),
                  interactions_FDR_le_0.10 = sum(inter$interaction_FDR <= FDR))
write.csv(inter, file.path(OUTP, "3a_coupling_by_metabolite.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(s3a, file.path(OUTP, "3a_coupling_summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n== Step 3a: liver–serum coupling, low vs high discordant pPRS ==\n"); print(s3a, row.names = FALSE)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3b. liver TG vs serum TG coupling x pPRS
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
tgc <- function(x) {
  d <- meta[, c("TG_serum", "TG_liver", x, BASE)]; d <- d[complete.cases(d), ]
  names(d)[3] <- "g"
  co <- summary(lm(TG_serum ~ TG_liver * g + age + sex + bmi, d))$coefficients
  hi <- d$g > median(d$g)
  data.frame(pPRS = x, n = nrow(d),
             rho_liverTG_serumTG_low = round(cor(d$TG_liver[!hi], d$TG_serum[!hi], method = "spearman"), 3),
             rho_liverTG_serumTG_high = round(cor(d$TG_liver[hi], d$TG_serum[hi], method = "spearman"), 3),
             interaction_beta = round(co["TG_liver:g", 1], 3), interaction_p = signif(co["TG_liver:g", 4], 3))
}
s3b <- rbind(tgc("pprs_disc"), tgc("pprs_conc"))
write.csv(s3b, file.path(OUTP, "3b_TG_coupling.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n== Step 3b: liver TG vs serum TG coupling ==\n"); print(s3b, row.names = FALSE)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3c. liver-minus-serum gap (matched panel) vs pPRS
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
s3c <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("pprs_disc", "pprs_conc"), function(x) {
  r <- run_limma(D, df, x, BASE)
  data.frame(pPRS = x, metabolite = r$feature, gap_beta_per_SD = round(r$logFC, 3),
             p = signif(r$P, 3), FDR = signif(r$FDR, 3))
}))
s3c <- s3c[order(s3c$pPRS, s3c$p), ]
write.csv(s3c, file.path(OUTP, "3c_gap_vs_pprs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n== Step 3c: metabolites whose liver-minus-serum gap relates to pPRS (FDR <= 0.10) ==\n")
print(aggregate(FDR ~ pPRS, s3c, function(v) sum(v <= FDR)))
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 3d. does serum predict histology worse when discordant pPRS is high?
##     one cross-validated model in everyone; AUC evaluated in each half
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
s3d <- list()
for (o in c("steatosis", "inflammation", "MASH")) {
  y <- df[[o]]
  ok <- !is.na(y) & !is.na(df$pprs_disc) & complete.cases(Xclin)
  yy <- y[ok]; hi <- df$pprs_disc[ok] > median(df$pprs_disc[ok])
  rs <- cv_auc(Sp[paired, ][ok, ], yy, rep(1, ncol(Sp)))
  rc <- cv_auc(Xclin[ok, , drop = FALSE], yy, rep(0, ncol(Xclin)))
  for (set in c("serum_all", "clinical")) {
    pr <- if (set == "serum_all") rs$oof else rc$oof
    r_lo <- roc(yy[!hi], pr[!hi], levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
    r_hi <- roc(yy[hi],  pr[hi],  levels = c(0, 1), direction = "<", quiet = TRUE)
    s3d[[length(s3d) + 1]] <- data.frame(outcome = o, predictors = set,
      n_low = sum(!hi), cases_low = sum(yy[!hi]), AUC_low_pPRS = round(as.numeric(auc(r_lo)), 3),
      n_high = sum(hi), cases_high = sum(yy[hi]), AUC_high_pPRS = round(as.numeric(auc(r_hi)), 3),
      DeLong_p_unpaired = signif(roc.test(r_lo, r_hi, method = "delong", paired = FALSE)$p.value, 3))
  }
}
s3d <- do.call(rbind, s3d)
write.csv(s3d, file.path(OUTP, "3d_auc_by_pprs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n== Step 3d: AUC in low vs high discordant pPRS ==\n"); print(s3d, row.names = FALSE)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## 4. genetic mediation: pPRS -> hepatic TG index -> histology
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
s4 <- list()
for (x in c("pprs_disc", "pprs_conc")) for (o in c("steatosis", "inflammation", "MASH", "fibrosis")) {
  d <- meta[, c(o, x, "TG_liver", BASE)]; d <- d[complete.cases(d), ]
  names(d)[1:2] <- c("y", "g")
  mfit <- lm(TG_liver ~ g + age + sex + bmi, d)
  ofit <- glm(y ~ TG_liver + g + age + sex + bmi, family = binomial, data = d)
  set.seed(7)
  m <- mediation::mediate(mfit, ofit, treat = "g", mediator = "TG_liver", boot = TRUE, sims = N_BOOT)
  s4[[length(s4) + 1]] <- data.frame(pPRS = x, outcome = o, n = nrow(d), cases = sum(d$y),
    pPRS_to_TG_beta = round(coef(mfit)["g"], 3),
    pPRS_to_TG_p = signif(summary(mfit)$coefficients["g", 4], 3),
    ACME = round(m$d.avg, 4), ACME_CI = sprintf("%.4f to %.4f", m$d.avg.ci[1], m$d.avg.ci[2]),
    ACME_p = signif(m$d.avg.p, 3),
    direct = round(m$z.avg, 4), direct_p = signif(m$z.avg.p, 3),
    total = round(m$tau.coef, 4), total_p = signif(m$tau.p, 3),
    prop_mediated = round(m$n.avg, 3))
}
s4 <- do.call(rbind, s4)
s4$ACME_FDR <- signif(p.adjust(s4$ACME_p, "BH"), 3)
write.csv(s4, file.path(OUTP, "4_genetic_mediation.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n== Step 4: pPRS -> hepatic TG -> histology ==\n")
print(s4[, c("pPRS", "outcome", "n", "pPRS_to_TG_beta", "pPRS_to_TG_p", "ACME", "ACME_p",
             "ACME_FDR", "total_p", "prop_mediated")], row.names = FALSE)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## summary
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
sink(file.path(OUTP, "summary_pprs.txt"), split = TRUE)
cat("pPRS SUMMARY\n============\n")
cat("pPRS available: metadata", sum(!is.na(meta$pprs_disc)), "| paired", sum(!is.na(df$pprs_disc)), "\n\n")
cat("Step 1 sanity (beta per SD, p):\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(s1))) cat(sprintf("  %-12s %-10s beta %6.3f  p %.3g  %s\n", s1$outcome[i], s1$pPRS[i],
                                        s1$beta_per_SD[i], s1$p[i], ifelse(s1$as_expected[i], "as expected", "NOT as expected")))
cat("\nStep 2 key-6 amino-acid discordance for inflammation:\n")
for (cn in names(cov_sets)) cat(sprintf("  %-20s %d of 6\n", cn,
  s2$key6_discordant[s2$model == cn & s2$trait == "inflammation"]))
cat(sprintf("\nStep 3a median liver-serum rho: low pPRS %.3f, high pPRS %.3f (permutation p = %.3g)\n",
            s3a$median_rho_low, s3a$median_rho_high, s3a$permutation_p))
cat(sprintf("Step 3b liver TG x discordant pPRS on serum TG: beta %.3f, p = %.3g\n",
            s3b$interaction_beta[1], s3b$interaction_p[1]))
cat("Step 3c gap metabolites FDR<=0.10:", sum(s3c$FDR[s3c$pPRS == "pprs_disc"] <= FDR), "(discordant),",
    sum(s3c$FDR[s3c$pPRS == "pprs_conc"] <= FDR), "(concordant)\n")
cat("Step 3d serum AUC low vs high pPRS:\n")
x <- s3d[s3d$predictors == "serum_all", ]
for (i in seq_len(nrow(x))) cat(sprintf("  %-12s %.3f vs %.3f (p = %.3g)\n", x$outcome[i],
                                       x$AUC_low_pPRS[i], x$AUC_high_pPRS[i], x$DeLong_p_unpaired[i]))
cat("Step 4 mediation via hepatic TG (ACME FDR):\n")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(s4))) cat(sprintf("  %-10s %-12s ACME %.4f  FDR %.3g  prop %.2f\n", s4$pPRS[i],
                                        s4$outcome[i], s4$ACME[i], s4$ACME_FDR[i], s4$prop_mediated[i]))
sink()
cat("\nDone. Wrote all files to", OUTP, "\n")
```

```{r partitio-02}
## =====================================================================
##  Figure: genetic predisposition to hepatic lipid retention (pPRS)
##  a  pPRS effects on hepatic TG, serum TG, steatosis grade, NAS
##  b  discordant pPRS: hepatic TG up, serum TG down (same people)
##  c  mediation: discordant pPRS -> hepatic TG -> histology
##  d  liver–serum coupling of 40 matched metabolites, low vs high pPRS
##
##  Run in the same R session after pPRS_liver_serum.R (uses `meta`),
##  from the folder that contains pprs_liver_serum/.
##  Output: Fig_pPRS.pdf (vector) and Fig_pPRS.png (600 dpi), 180 mm wide
## =====================================================================
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(ggrepel)
})
if (!exists("meta") || !"pprs_disc" %in% names(meta)) stop("run pPRS_liver_serum.R first")
IN <- "pprs_liver_serum"
N_BOOT_PLOT <- 2000                 # same as the analysis -> identical estimates (seed 7)
## palette (validated: blue/orange pass CVD and contrast checks) + neutral inks
COL   <- c(Discordant = "#2a78d6", Concordant = "#eb6834")
INK   <- "#0b0b0b"; INK2 <- "#52514e"; MUTED <- "#8d8c86"; GRID <- "#e8e7e2"; PT <- "#b9b8b1"
EFF   <- c("Indirect (via hepatic TG)" = "#2a78d6", "Direct" = "#a9a8a1", "Total" = "#0b0b0b")
theme_pub <- function(base = 8.5) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base, base_family = "Helvetica") +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.3),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = INK2),
          axis.title = element_text(colour = INK),
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = INK, size = base + 1, margin = margin(b = 4)),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(colour = INK2, size = base - 0.5, margin = margin(b = 6)),
          legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
          legend.title = element_blank(), legend.text = element_text(colour = INK),
          legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), legend.key.size = unit(3.5, "mm"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", colour = INK, hjust = 0),
          plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = base + 3, colour = INK),
          plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 4))
}
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "e", digits = 1)),
                            paste0("p = ", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3)))
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## a. pPRS effects (beta per SD, 95% CI)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
s1 <- read.csv(file.path(IN, "1_sanity_check.csv")) %>%
  mutate(score = factor(ifelse(pPRS == "pprs_disc", "Discordant", "Concordant"),
                        levels = c("Discordant", "Concordant")),
         outcome = factor(outcome, levels = rev(c("TG_liver", "TG_serum", "steat_grade", "NAS")),
                          labels = rev(c("Hepatic TG", "Serum TG", "Steatosis grade", "NAS"))),
         lo = beta_per_SD - 1.96 * SE, hi = beta_per_SD + 1.96 * SE)
x_lab_a <- max(s1$hi) + 0.06
pd_a <- position_dodge(width = 0.62)
pa <- ggplot(s1, aes(beta_per_SD, outcome, colour = score)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = INK2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), linewidth = 0.8, position = pd_a) +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, position = pd_a, stroke = 0) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x_lab_a, label = fmt_p(p), group = score), position = pd_a,
            hjust = 0, size = 2.5, colour = INK2, family = "Helvetica") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = COL, labels = c("Discordant pPRS", "Concordant pPRS")) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.38))) +
  labs(x = "β per SD of pPRS (95% CI)", y = NULL,
       title = "Genetic scores for liver fat",
       subtitle = "Adjusted for age, sex and BMI (n = 211)") +
  theme_pub() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## b. discordant pPRS vs hepatic and serum TG (same participants)
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
d_b <- meta %>% filter(!is.na(pprs_disc)) %>%
  dplyr::select(pprs_disc, TG_liver, TG_serum) %>%
  pivot_longer(-pprs_disc, names_to = "compartment", values_to = "z") %>%
  filter(!is.na(z)) %>%
  mutate(compartment = factor(compartment, levels = c("TG_liver", "TG_serum"),
                              labels = c("Hepatic TG", "Serum TG")))
ann_b <- s1 %>% filter(score == "Discordant", outcome %in% c("Hepatic TG", "Serum TG")) %>%
  transmute(compartment = factor(as.character(outcome), levels = c("Hepatic TG", "Serum TG")),
            label = sprintf("β = %.2f\n%s", beta_per_SD, fmt_p(p)))
pb <- ggplot(d_b, aes(pprs_disc, z)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(colour = PT, size = 1.1, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, colour = COL["Discordant"],
              fill = COL["Discordant"], alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = ann_b, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label), hjust = -0.08, vjust = 1.25,
            size = 2.6, colour = INK, family = "Helvetica", lineheight = 0.95) +
  facet_wrap(~ compartment, nrow = 1) +
  labs(x = "Discordant pPRS (SD)", y = "Triglycerides (SD)",
       title = "Same scores, opposite compartments",
       subtitle = "Hepatic TG rises while serum TG falls") +
  theme_pub()
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## c. mediation: discordant pPRS -> hepatic TG -> histology
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
med <- bind_rows(lapply(c("steatosis", "inflammation", "MASH", "fibrosis"), function(o) {
  d <- meta[, c(o, "pprs_disc", "TG_liver", "age", "sex", "bmi")]; d <- d[complete.cases(d), ]
  names(d)[1:2] <- c("y", "g")
  mf <- lm(TG_liver ~ g + age + sex + bmi, d)
  of <- glm(y ~ TG_liver + g + age + sex + bmi, family = binomial, data = d)
  set.seed(7)
  m <- mediation::mediate(mf, of, treat = "g", mediator = "TG_liver", boot = TRUE, sims = N_BOOT_PLOT)
  data.frame(outcome = o,
             effect = c("Indirect (via hepatic TG)", "Direct", "Total"),
             est = 100 * c(m$d.avg, m$z.avg, m$tau.coef),
             lo  = 100 * c(m$d.avg.ci[1], m$z.avg.ci[1], m$tau.ci[1]),
             hi  = 100 * c(m$d.avg.ci[2], m$z.avg.ci[2], m$tau.ci[2]),
             prop = m$n.avg, total_p = m$tau.p)
}))
write.csv(med, file.path(IN, "4_mediation_for_plot.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
med <- med %>%
  mutate(outcome_lab = recode(outcome, steatosis = "Steatosis", inflammation = "Lobular\ninflammation",
                              MASH = "MASH", fibrosis = "Fibrosis (F1–F4)"),
         outcome_lab = factor(outcome_lab, levels = rev(c("Steatosis", "Lobular\ninflammation", "MASH", "Fibrosis (F1–F4)"))),
         effect = factor(effect, levels = rev(names(EFF))))
lab_c <- med %>% group_by(outcome_lab) %>% summarise(prop = first(prop), total_p = first(total_p), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(total_p < 0.05, sprintf("%.0f%% mediated", pmin(prop, 1) * 100),
                        "total effect n.s."))
x_lab_c <- max(med$hi) + 1
pd_c <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)
pc <- ggplot(med, aes(est, outcome_lab, colour = effect)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = INK2, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), linewidth = 0.8, position = pd_c) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4, position = pd_c, stroke = 0) +
  geom_text(data = lab_c, aes(x = x_lab_c, y = outcome_lab, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            hjust = 0, size = 2.5, colour = INK2, family = "Helvetica") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = EFF, breaks = names(EFF)) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.04, 0.45))) +
  labs(x = "Effect per SD of discordant pPRS\n(percentage points, 95% CI)", y = NULL,
       title = "Genetic effect runs through hepatic fat",
       subtitle = "Discordant pPRS → hepatic TG → histology (2,000 bootstraps)") +
  theme_pub() + theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## d. liver–serum coupling, low vs high discordant pPRS
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
cp  <- read.csv(file.path(IN, "3a_coupling_by_metabolite.csv"))
cps <- read.csv(file.path(IN, "3a_coupling_summary.csv"))
pretty_name <- function(x) {
  x <- gsub("_", " ", x)
  ifelse(grepl("^[A-Z]{2,5}$", x), x,
         paste0(toupper(substr(tolower(x), 1, 1)), substring(tolower(x), 2)))
}
cp <- cp %>% mutate(name = pretty_name(metabolite),
                    show = rank(-abs(rho_high_pPRS - rho_low_pPRS)) <= 4 | rank(-rho_low_pPRS) <= 2)
lim <- range(c(cp$rho_low_pPRS, cp$rho_high_pPRS)) + c(-0.05, 0.05)
pdd <- ggplot(cp, aes(rho_low_pPRS, rho_high_pPRS)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, colour = MUTED, linewidth = 0.4, linetype = "22") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = GRID, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_point(colour = COL["Discordant"], size = 2, alpha = 0.85, stroke = 0) +
  geom_text_repel(data = filter(cp, show), aes(label = name), size = 2.4, colour = INK2,
                  family = "Helvetica", segment.colour = MUTED, segment.size = 0.25,
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.35, seed = 1) +
  annotate("text", x = lim[2], y = lim[1], hjust = 1, vjust = 0, size = 2.6, colour = INK,
           family = "Helvetica", lineheight = 0.95,
           label = sprintf("Median ρ %.2f vs %.2f\npermutation p = %.2f",
                           cps$median_rho_low, cps$median_rho_high, cps$permutation_p)) +
  coord_equal(xlim = lim, ylim = lim) +
  labs(x = sprintf("Liver–serum ρ, low pPRS (n = %d)", cps$n_low),
       y = sprintf("Liver–serum ρ, high pPRS (n = %d)", cps$n_high),
       title = "Uncoupling is not genetic",
       subtitle = "40 matched metabolites; dashed line = equal") +
  theme_pub()
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
## assemble and save
## ---------------------------------------------------------------------
fig <- (pa | pb) / (pc | pdd) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1.15), heights = c(1, 1.1)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a")
dev_pdf <- if (capabilities("cairo")) cairo_pdf else "pdf"
ggsave("Fig5_pPRS.pdf", fig, width = 180, height = 165, units = "mm", device = dev_pdf)
ggsave("Fig5_pPRS.png", fig, width = 180, height = 165, units = "mm", dpi = 600, bg = "white")
cat("Saved Fig5_pPRS.pdf and Fig5_pPRS.png in", getwd(), "\n")
```
